operation_counter_semantics.block_allocations: direct non-null blocks returned by BlockPool.get_new_blocks
operation_counter_semantics.block_frees: derived-exact from pre-call ref_cnt==1 non-null blocks on successful free_blocks calls
operation_counter_semantics.block_table_writes: direct CPU integer slots written by MultiGroupBlockTable add/append
operation_counter_semantics.branch_session_metadata_allocations: direct SLOForge logical branch/session objects created
operation_counter_semantics.output_token_commits: direct new token IDs returned by Scheduler.update_from_output
operation_counter_semantics.prefix_block_candidates: direct available request.block_hashes length, not probes executed
operation_counter_semantics.prefix_blocks_bound: direct cached blocks passed to coordinator allocation
operation_counter_semantics.prefix_hash_hits: FULL direct probe results; MINIMAL derived-exact aligned hit blocks
operation_counter_semantics.prefix_hash_lookups: FULL direct probes; MINIMAL derived-exact from aligned returned hits and pinned early-miss loop
operation_counter_semantics.prefix_hash_misses: FULL direct probe results; MINIMAL derived-exact early-miss indicator
operation_counter_semantics.private_suffix_allocations: direct coordinator blocks allocated for shared-root requests only
operation_counter_semantics.prompt_token_writes: direct prompt token IDs copied into frontend request lists
operation_counter_semantics.refcount_decrements: direct blocks passed to successful-path BlockPool.free_blocks
operation_counter_semantics.refcount_increments: direct blocks passed to successful BlockPool.touch plus blocks returned by get_new_blocks
operation_counter_semantics.request_block_hashes_computed: direct hashes returned by the original request hasher
operation_counter_semantics.scheduler_candidate_evaluations: direct get_computed_blocks calls; equals candidates only for the validated unblocked FCFS path
operation_counter_semantics.scheduler_queue_removals: derived-exact scheduled_new_reqs count for the validated new-request/no-preemption path
operation_counter_semantics.scheduler_scans: direct Scheduler.schedule calls, not queue entries inspected

BLOCK_TABLE_BUILD.scope: scheduler prefix binding and GPU-worker CPU block-table writes

GPU_EXECUTION.scope: GPUModelRunner execute_model plus sample_tokens/bookkeeping/output synchronization; not pure device time

PHYSICAL_KV_METADATA.scope: no standalone span; physical handling is decomposed into prefix_metadata_other, table, refcount, and allocation stages

POST_ROOT_READY.scope: continuous runner boundary from root-available branch work to all first outputs

PREFIX_LOOKUP.scope: KVCacheManager.get_computed_blocks and optional FULL per-probe spans

PREFIX_METADATA_OTHER.scope: PREFIX_STATE_BIND wall minus nested lookup/table/refcount/allocation spans

PREFIX_STATE_BIND.scope: KVCacheManager allocate/free inclusive grouping; exclusive time is prefix_metadata_other

REQUEST_BUILD.scope: adapter submission plus nested vLLM request construction and hashing

RESIDUAL.scope: POST_ROOT_READY minus all non-overlapping classified children

SCHEDULER_SELECT.scope: Scheduler.schedule inclusive; decomposition uses exclusive time

SCHEDULER_WAIT.scope: last successful submit end to first Scheduler.schedule entry
